from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u007/system/state/workspace')
programs=base/'programs'
programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cuts = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if 0 < r < h - 1 and len(set(row)) == 1:
            cuts.append(("row", r))
    for c in range(w):
        col = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        if 0 < c < w - 1 and len(set(col)) == 1:
            cuts.append(("col", c))
    for axis, k in cuts:
        if axis == "row":
            a, b = grid[:k], grid[k + 1:]
            if len(a) != len(b) or not a or len(a[0]) != len(b[0]):
                continue
        else:
            a = [row[:k] for row in grid]
            b = [row[k + 1:] for row in grid]
            if len(a[0]) != len(b[0]) or not a[0]:
                continue
        common = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
        if len(common) != 1:
            continue
        mismatch = next(iter(common))
        return [[3 if x == y else mismatch for x, y in zip(ar, br)] for ar, br in zip(a, b)]
    raise ValueError("No matching pair of panels separated by a uniform line")
'''
path=programs/'task-b6f2acb3.py'
path.write_text(code)
print(path, path.exists())
